forcing.ocean: HYCOM GOFS 3.1 GLBv0.08, 15 m, 3 h (STEP 17 locked)

model.equation: dX/dt = U_ocean(15 m) + alpha * U_wind(10 m)
model.coordinateConversion: spherical geographic: dlon/dt = u/(R_deg*cos(lat)), dlat/dt = v/R_deg, R_deg = 1852*60 m/deg, evaluated at the current latitude at every RK4 stage; no fixed km/deg constant
model.integrator: RK4, ocean and wind re-interpolated at all four stages, alpha*U_wind added at every stage

time.integrationStepRationale: locked runtime preflight (models.py, immutable V1 source) enforces integrationStepSeconds <= floor(min_grid_m/(4*max_speed)); from the STEP 17 Phase B normalized forcing this bound is KE-1 655 s, KE-2 733 s, AG-1 579 s, AG-2 663 s, so 900 s is rejected for all four windows; 300 s (runtime default, same as STEP 11) satisfies all four; 900 s is therefore the output/evaluation/status timestep and the RK4 substep is 300 s; fixed before any run and not changed afterwards

interpolation.spatial: bilinear on native grids (HYCOM 0.08° regular; NCEP Gaussian)

domain.computationArea: locked ocean forcing coverage ∩ experiment domain (per run unit, see runUnits[].computationArea)
domain.runtimeSpecArea: area = runUnits[].computationArea (manifest oceanDomain values; latitude clipped)
domain.windBoxContainsArea: ocean box ± 3.0° contains the computation area corners (verified by the validator from manifest coordinates)

statusRules.OUT_OF_DOMAIN: particle latitude leaves [-40, 40] (global/domain rule kept from STEP 18)
statusRules.FORCING_UNAVAILABLE: no forcing at that time/position: crossing a computation-area edge that is not the ±40° latitude, outside forcing grid, null node, land-mask node, wind box/time outside

runtimeMapping.OUT_OF_DOMAIN: OUT_OF_DOMAIN only when the last safe position lies on the ±40° latitude boundary (bisection tolerance 1e-6°); otherwise FORCING_UNAVAILABLE

statusRules.onTermination: terminate that drifter's run at that timestep; last valid=true point is the previous output timestep; runtime boundary-crossing sample exported with valid=false; drifter never removed; no rows after termination; metrics NOT_AVAILABLE for missing horizons
statusRules.AG-1: t0 latitudes down to -39.8; OUT_OF_DOMAIN south of -40 recorded as-is; no special handling
statusRules.releasePreflightFailure: record that drifter at t0 as FORCING_UNAVAILABLE (single row, valid=false); run continues; STEP 17 QC showed all 23 t0 stencils valid, so an occurrence is treated as a forcing mismatch and documented

columnRules.valid: true for ACTIVE/COMPLETED model positions, false for termination rows

output.optionalVelocityColumns: NOT INCLUDED (runtime result has no velocities; post-hoc re-evaluation would be derived, excluded now)

replay.criterion: result array SHA-256 identical → replayMatched true; mismatch → MODEL_RUN_FAIL
replay.when: after all 8 runs complete, same inputs

metrics.observationMatching: exact UTC timestamp match with STEP 15 hourly QC files; no interpolation; missing → NOT_AVAILABLE
metrics.M1: 72 h endpoint displacement: release point → model position at t0+72h; NOT_AVAILABLE if not valid at t0+72h
metrics.M2: total trajectory displacement: sum of distances between consecutive valid=true output points up to the last valid point; valid duration (h) recorded
metrics.M3: observed-vs-modeled position error at every on-the-hour timestamp with an observation; horizons 24/48/72 h reported separately; NOT_AVAILABLE if model not valid or no observation
metrics.M4: alpha effect: RUN A vs RUN B position distance at timestamps where both valid; paired difference A−B of M3(72 h) when both available
metrics.M5: observed 72 h displacement (reference against cohort A2)
metrics.aggregation: per run, per run unit, overall (23): n, median, mean, min, max; paired metrics on the same drifter only
metrics.acceptanceThresholds: NONE in this protocol — trajectory production and descriptive statistics only; PASS/FAIL judgement requires a separate preregistration fixing STEP 12 K1–K5 numerically (validation-plan-v3)
metrics.independenceNote: temporal overlap within and across windows does not imply statistical independence; n=23 is not an independent sample count
metrics.confidenceIntervals: none for the deterministic model; no bootstrap at this step

failurePolicy.preflightError: MODEL_RUN_BLOCKED_PREFLIGHT (no run; no parameter change to satisfy the bound)
failurePolicy.runtimeException: MODEL_RUN_FAIL; partial output preserved; one retry with identical input only
failurePolicy.earlyTermination: not a failure; recorded; metrics NOT_AVAILABLE
failurePolicy.allRunsCompleteAndReplayMatched: MODEL_RUN_PASS (trajectory production only, not validation PASS)

prohibited: changing alpha, integration/output step, domain, status rules, metrics or output schema after seeing results
lockPolicy: after LOCK no change to model, equation, timestep, interpolation, domain, status rules, runs, output schema, manifest fields, metrics or failure policy; changes require a new ruleId
